# viettelcloud_lb_l7_rule (Data Source)

Read details of a Viettel Cloud Load Balancer L7 Rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup Load Balancer L7 Rule by ID
data "viettelcloud_lb_l7_rule" "by_id" {
  l7_policy_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  id           = "11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `l7_policy_id` (String) L7 Policy ID (UUID) that owns the L7 rule.

### Optional

- `id` (String) L7 Rule ID (UUID).

### Read-Only

- `compare_type` (String) Comparison type.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the L7 rule was created (RFC3339).
- `invert` (Boolean) Whether the rule match is inverted.
- `key` (String) Key to match against.
- `provisioning_status` (String) Current provisioning status of the L7 rule.
- `status` (String) Current operating status of the L7 rule.
- `type` (String) Rule type.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the L7 rule was last updated (RFC3339).
- `value` (String) Value to compare against.
